standard_reference.name: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English
standard_reference.implementation_basis: Public guidance from the ASD Simplified Technical English Maintenance Group

full_compliance_requires: the complete approved dictionary and writing rules
independent evidence for any certification claim

procedure.purpose: Instructions, forms, errors, recovery steps, and operator actions
rules: Write one instruction in each sentence.
Put a required condition before the action.
Name the person or system that does the action.

description.purpose: Service explanations, technical descriptions, field reports, FAQs, and supporting marketing copy
rules: Use the active voice when the actor is known.
Write one topic in each paragraph.
Use a vertical list when one sentence contains a complex series.
Use one stable term for one meaning.

brand-heading.purpose: Campaign titles, product names, concise display headings, and established public phrases
rules: Keep the heading clear in its rendered context.
Do not use the exception for explanatory body copy.

exact-content.purpose: Code, proof identifiers, quotations, vendor names, legal text, and externally controlled strings
rules: Keep the exception as narrow as possible.
Do not use the exception to conceal public claims.

technical_terms.definition: A named sequence of work, decisions, and records.
Software that can inspect context and take an allowed action.
Model intelligence used inside a named workflow.
The Model Context Protocol contract that exposes approved resources and tools.
The CREATE SOMETHING owned database and operator layer.
The CREATE SOMETHING product that records the workflow definition.
The CREATE SOMETHING implementation service for an approved Map.
The CREATE SOMETHING product for governed workflow operation.
A change or request that can start workflow work.
The point where an allowed action, approval, wait, or stop is selected.
The evidence and record that show what happened.
A durable record of a workflow event or result.
The ordered records that let a person inspect past workflow actions.

active_route_audit.scope: current public backlog after redirect and archive exclusions
